description: Historical routes driven by Amazon delivery drivers in five US metropolitan areas, with route, stop and package level features and the sequence each driver actually followed. Released for the 2021 Amazon Last Mile Routing Research Challenge with identifiers regenerated and locations obfuscated.
name: Amazon Last Mile Routing Research Challenge 2021

recipe.reason: The data is large nested JSON with bare NaN tokens, the largest file is 1.8 GB, and keepset has no JSON parser for it.
